subject: Gerudo's Membership Card
text: Freeing all four craftsmen from jail in Gerudo's Fortress allows Link to obtain the Gerudo's Membership Card.

evidence.quote: Free all four craftsmen in jail, to roam free in Gerudo's Fortress.

subject: Horseback Archery minigame
text: Scoring 1,500 points in the Horseback Archery minigame rewards Link with an upgrade.

evidence.quote: 1,500 points from the Archery Minigame to obtain the Upgrade.

subject: Horseback Archery minigame
text: In the Horseback Archery minigame, players should shoot all bottom pots, then hit the first middle-left target as much as possible while turning around.

evidence.quote: Shoot all the pots on the bottom then when you are turning around shoot the first target on the left middle as much as you can.

subject: Nayru's Love
text: Upon entering Desert Colossus, blow up a cracked wall on the right side to reveal a hidden Fairy Fountain containing Nayru's Love.

evidence.quote: As soon as you enter to Desert Colossus you will a cracked wall on your right side. Blow up to reveal a hidden Fairy Fountain.

subject: Silver Gauntlets
text: Young Link obtains the Silver Gauntlets in the Spirit Temple.

evidence.quote: [Story Progression] Young Link in the Spirit Temple.

subject: Twinrova Sisters
text: Twinrova Sisters can be easily fought by not Z-targeting, moving to the corners, reflecting magic blasts at the other witch with the shield, and using the hookshot on her final form when down.

evidence.quote: This is very easy if you use the hookshot on the final form of the boss when she is down....Once one of the witches fires their shot, use your shield to bring the blast to the other witch flying around. The key is to never z lock targert the witches.

subject: Twinrova Sisters
text: Absorb three fire or ice attacks in a row, then jump slash over or hookshot to Twinrova.

evidence.quote: Get three fires or ices in a row, then jump slash over or if you feel unsafe use a hookshot to her.

subject: Spirit Medallion
text: Link awakes Nabooru and obtains the Spirit Medallion after defeating the Twinrova Sisters.

evidence.quote: [Story Progression] After defeating Twinrova Sisters.

subject: Big Poes
text: Big Poes spawn day and night, are easier to find on Epona, and turning in all 10 awards the fourth bottle.

evidence.quote: _Catch all 10 Big Poes and obtain your reward_ ... Big Poes spawn day/night and are easier to find if you are on epona.

subject: Big Poe #1
text: Big Poe #1 spawns at the entrance of Hyrule Castle at the Y split in the road.

evidence.quote: 1. At the entrance of Hyrule Castle, at the Y split in the road.

subject: Big Poe #2
text: Big Poe #2 spawns next to Lon Lon Ranch entrance on the right side next to a tree.

evidence.quote: 2. Next to Lon Lon Ranch entrance, right side next to to tree.

subject: Big Poe #3
text: Big Poe #3 spawns on the left side of Hyrule Castle next to the river, by a tree.

evidence.quote: 3. Left side of Hyrule Castle next to river, by a tree.

subject: Big Poe #4
text: Big Poe #4 spawns next to the Gerudo Valley entrance at ground level on the left side, at the start of the road leading to Lon Lon Ranch.

evidence.quote: 4. Next to Gerudo Valley Entrance, ground level. Left side, start of road leading to Lon Lon Ranch.

subject: Big Poe #5
text: Big Poe #5 spawns next to the Gerudo Valley entrance at ground level on the right side, at the start of the road leading to Lake Hylia.

evidence.quote: 5. Next to Gerudo Valley Entrance, Ground level. Right side, Start of road leading to Lake Hylia

subject: Big Poe #6
text: Big Poe #6 spawns at the end of the road on the south side of Lake Hylia between two trees leading to the Castle.

evidence.quote: 6. At the end of the road, south side Lake Hylia. In between two trees leading to the Castle.

subject: Big Poe #7
text: Big Poe #7 spawns next to #6 in the south side trees, passing by the tree on the left side.

evidence.quote: 7. Next to #6 in the tree's south side, pass by the tree on left side.

subject: Big Poe #8
text: Big Poe #8 spawns next to Lon Lon Ranch on the right side, at the Y split in the road.

evidence.quote: 8. Next to Lon Lon Ranch on right side, at the Y split in the road.

subject: Big Poe #9
text: Big Poe #9 spawns in between #1 and #8 on ground level near the cliff.

evidence.quote: 9. In between # 1 and # 8, on the ground level near the cliff.

subject: Big Poe #10
text: Big Poe #10 spawns near the entrance of Kakariko Village at ground level when walking near the water.

evidence.quote: 10. Near the entrance of Kakariko Village, ground level walk near water to trigger.

subject: Bottles
text: The four bottles are obtained by finding seven Cuccos for Anju in Kakariko Village, playing the Super Cucco Game at Lon Lon Ranch, finding Ruto's Letter in Lake Hylia as Young Link, and finding all ten big poes in Hyrule Field.

evidence.quote:
- [ ] Finding all seven Cuccos for Anju in Kakariko Village
- [ ] Playing the Super Cucco Game at Lon Lon Ranch 
- [ ] Finding Ruto's Letter in Lake Hylia as Young Link
- [ ] Finding all ten big poes in Hyrule Field.

subject: Dampé's race
text: In Dampé's Crypt, players can race under 1:30 and use the Longshot on the light at the end to gain time.

evidence.quote: Go back to Dampé's Crypt and race under 1:30, you can use your longshot at the end to hook on the light to gain enough time.

subject: Pond owner's hat
text: Standing in front of the pond owner lets Link hook his hat with the fishing pole, which can then be cast into the pond to remove it permanently.

evidence.quote: This is very tricky to pull off, but you want to stand in front of the pond owner and eventually you will grab his hat with your fishing pole. From there you want to cast it out into the pond to have his hat permanently go away.

subject: Hyrule Loach
text: The Hyrule Loach appears every 4th time by playing the Sun's Song outside and re-entering the pond to check near the lily pads.

evidence.quote:
1. Enter the pond and check the lily pads to the left if Loach is there. [Long big fish]
2. If fish is not there go outside, play song of sun re enter. The Loach appears every 4th time.

subject: Princess Zelda
text: Link meets Princess Zelda one last time before the final showdown at the Temple of Time.

evidence.quote: [Story Progression] Temple of Time.

subject: Fairy Fountain
text: After getting the gauntlet upgrade in Ganon's Castle Shadow Trial, go back outside and move the rock with the gauntlet to find a hidden Fairy Fountain.

evidence.quote: Get the gauntlet upgrade in Ganon's Castle Shadow Trial, then go back outside move rock with gauntlet to find hidden Fairy Fountain.

subject: Ganondorf
text: Equip Hover Boots immediately and stand in the corner to avoid falling off the ledge, and hit Ganondorf with a Light Arrow before walking over to attack.

evidence.quote: Equip the hover boots as soon as possible and walk over to the corner. You can get hit, just make sure you always have the boots equipped so you don't fall down the ledge. It's really not too hard just make sure you hit him with a light arrow before you walk over to the other side when attacking ganon.

subject: Ganon
text: Roll in between Ganon's legs right before he swings, then attack his tail.

evidence.quote: This is the easiest fight known to zelda, all you do is roll right before ganon is about to swing in between his legs. Attack his tail , rinse and repeat.

subject: Ganon
text: Defeating Ganon banishes him to the void of the Evil Realm.

evidence.quote: [Story progression] After defeating ganon.

subject: Frog minigame
text: Playing Song of Storms after playing the other 5 regular songs gives the first heart piece, while the second frog minigame requires playing the note sequence A, L, R, D, L, R, D, A, D, A, D, R, L, A.

evidence.quote: [Play Song of Storms after playing the other 5 regular songs to get your first heart piece]...**[A, L, R, D, L, R, D, A, D, A, D, R, L, A]**

subject: Dampe excavation minigame
text: If Link digs up the heart piece in the Dampé excavation minigame and leaves the area without collecting it, the heart piece is lost forever and replaced by 50 rupees.

evidence.quote: This achievement can be lost in the dampe excavation minigame. If you dig up the heart piece and leave the area without collecting it, the heart piece will be lost forever and in exchange you will get 50 rupees.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: There are 36 heart pieces in total required to complete 20 hearts.

evidence.quote: 36 heart pieces in total for 20 hearts.

subject: 3 Heart Challenge
text: During the 3 heart challenge, players can pick up heart pieces but must never pick up a 4th heart piece to increase total health.

evidence.quote: If you pick up a heart piece it's okay, just don't pick up the 4th heart piece to increase your health further.

subject: Blind Explorer
text: Save before opening chests and reset if a map or compass is accidentally obtained during the Blind Explorer challenge.

evidence.quote: Make sure to save before the opening the chests and reset if you accidently got a map or compass.

subject: Ice arrow
text: Each room holds a key in the Gerudo's Training Ground, which are used to grab all the keys for the Ice arrow in the middle of the Training Ground.

evidence.quote: Each room holds a key in the Gerudo's Training Ground, use the items you obtained to grab all they keys for the Ice arrow in the middle of the Training Ground.

subject: Running Man challenge
text: Summoning Epona before the challenge makes it an easy win.

evidence.quote: Summon Epona before the Challenge and should be easy win.

subject: Gossip Stones
text: All Warp Songs are needed to unlock the Gossip Stones rumors.

evidence.quote: _[Need all Warp Songs to unlock]_
